question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
predicted_sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    -- Calculate total runs conceded per over per match
    SELECT 
        mb.match_id,
        mb.over_id,
        mb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_from_batsman,
        SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + SUM(er.extra_runs) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball mb
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs ON mb.match_id = bs.match_id AND mb.over_id = bs.over_id AND mb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND mb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er ON mb.match_id = er.match_id AND mb.over_id = er.over_id AND mb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND mb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY mb.match_id, mb.over_id, mb.bowler
),
match_max_over AS (
    -- Find the maximum runs conceded in each match
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs_conceded) as max_runs_in_match
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_runs AS (
    -- Get overs that had the maximum runs conceded in each match
    SELECT 
        or1.match_id,
        or1.over_id,
        or1.bowler,
        or1.total_runs_conceded
    FROM over_runs or1
    JOIN match_max_over mm ON or1.match_id = mm.match_id AND or1.total_runs_conceded = mm.max_runs_in_match
),
bowler_max_over AS (
    -- Find the maximum runs conceded by each bowler in a single over
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        MAX(total_runs_conceded) as max_runs_conceded
    FROM max_over_runs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top_bowlers AS (
    -- Get top 3 bowlers by max runs conceded in a single over
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        max_runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_max_over
    ORDER BY max_runs_conceded DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
final_result AS (
    -- Get the matches for these top bowlers where they conceded their maximum runs
    SELECT 
        mor.bowler,
        mor.match_id,
        mor.over_id,
        mor.total_runs_conceded,
        bmo.max_runs_conceded as bowler_max_runs,
        p.player_name
    FROM max_over_runs mor
    JOIN top_bowlers tb ON mor.bowler = tb.bowler
    JOIN bowler_max_over bmo ON mor.bowler = bmo.bowler AND mor.total_runs_conceded = bmo.max_runs_conceded
    JOIN ipl.main.player p ON mor.bowler = p.player_id
    ORDER BY mor.total_runs_conceded DESC
)
SELECT * FROM final_result

WITH player_stats AS (
    -- Calculate total runs and matches for each player
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS total_matches
    FROM ipl.player p
    LEFT JOIN ipl.player_match pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id AND bb.striker = p.player_id

    WHERE p.country_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.country_name
),

    SELECT 
        player_id,
        country_name,
        total_runs,

            ELSE 0
        END AS avg_runs_per_match
